name: Eat My Body
overview: Scripture reveals that Jesus presents Himself as the true bread of life, offering spiritual sustenance and eternal life to those who believe in Him. At the Last Supper, He took bread, blessed it, broke it, and identified it as His body given for His followers, commanding them to partake in remembrance of Him. Jesus emphasizes that receiving His flesh and blood is essential for spiritual life, underscoring the profound connection between faith in His sacrificial death and the believer's eternal nourishment.
